title: Improved Fruit Box
tagline: An improved version of the game "Fruit Box" in which you match apples such that they add up to ten
description: This project is an improved version of the game "Fruit Box", a game in which you match apples such that they add up to ten. Your goal is clear as many apples as you can before the time runs out. In the original version of this game, the board generation makes it so that it's almost impossible to fully clear the board, and this frustrates many players as seen on the r/FruitBox subreddit. We sought to fix that issue and add more features with our project.
how_its_made: We created this project using Unity and scripting in C#. We were also planning on adding the ability to purchase skins with Ethereum by adding on option to add your Metamask wallet, but we unfortunately ran out of time. The most hacky thing that we did that I am most proud of is figuring out what makes a board fully solvable.
